# Agent Laboratory source provenance

Selected immutable source snapshot from [SamuelSchmidgall/AgentLaboratory](https://github.com/SamuelSchmidgall/AgentLaboratory), commit `d9017d90e329112d2a80b7712f37ee9094d2cd27`, retrieved 2026-10-17 through GitHub file API. [manifest.json](manifest.json) records SHA-256 and byte counts. Original filenames and inline attributions are retained. This is not a complete runnable upstream checkout. SAGE never imports these files.

[Upstream MIT license](upstream/LICENSE): Copyright (c) 2025 Samuel Schmidgall. A separate copy applies to corresponding maintained derivatives at [LICENSES/Agent-Laboratory-MIT.txt](../../LICENSES/Agent-Laboratory-MIT.txt).

The upstream `papersolver.py` includes an inline attribution for its section tips to SakanaAI/AI-Scientist. The snapshot retains it; SAGE uses newly written section instructions rather than copying that tip table.

Actual maintained candidate editing, generation/repair, bounded selection, report generation and review are decomposed into `sage/execution`, `sage/writing`, `sage/review` and `sage/orchestration`. See [exact migration and deviations](../../docs/agent-laboratory-migration.md). Upstream arbitrary host execution, LaTeX compilation, automatic datasets, dependency installs and manuscript submission are not imported.
